text:
Priya: Quick ping — opened PR #65421 touching routing fallback order + auth header precedence. Need runtime + infra + security eyes. Planning to merge into canary tomorrow 09:00 PT if all green. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/65421

Alex: skimmed the diff — looks small. runtime should double-check kernel selection tweaks and fallback ordering interactions. @Sam @Len can you take a look?

Sam: I can take runtime eyes. Quick Q: are we changing default route policy or only the fallback ordering?

Priya: only fallback ordering, not default policy. Also fixes a subtle case where x-auth headers were being overridden by proxies. Added a short regression test.

infra-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, e2e). build #2208 ✅

Len: infra note — eviction behavior unchanged in my quick read. I want a short staging perf run to sanity-check p95. Can you attach the perf artifact to the PR?

Priya: done — uploaded perf_run_2026-03-19.json to the PR. Delta looks small: p95 tokens processing +1.2%, CPU p95 -1.5%.

Mike: security quick check — the auth header reorder could affect some legacy proxies that expect first-seen header. Can you add an explicit regression test for header ordering?

Priya: yep added header-ordering regression test and a changelog note. @security-team would appreciate an ack; test should exercise typical proxy chain.

Alex: plan: if runtime + infra + sec can ack by 08:30 PT tomorrow i'll merge into the canary window and watch telemetry for 1 hour. otherwise we'll delay to next slot.

Sam: ran a short perf pass locally against the canary image — p95 latency slightly better (-1.5%), memory stable. runtime +1 from me. :+1:

Len: infra lgtm, queued for merge window.

Mike: security lgtm after CI confirms the new test (watching the run).

Priya: thanks all — noted in the canary playbook and added a rollback note. Will hold if anything unexpected pops up.
